messages:
erin: quick recap from the GPTQ bakeoff across Llama/Mistral/Qwen — summary + next steps. uploading full artifacts to s3 tonight.

mike: thanks. quick list: quant methods compared?

erin: GPTQ-4, GPTQ-3 (experimental), AWQ-4, INT8 (where kernels exist), and a limited FP8 steer on Mistral.

julia: eval suites?

erin: MMLU, PIQA, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA, and our internal convo-eval for safety/regression. also long-context KV traces.

oz: top-line accuracy/latency/mem deltas vs FP16 (median across suites):

erin: short bullets:
- Llama-2-13B GPTQ-4: acc -1.9%, latency +24% (median token), mem x3.2. AWQ-4: acc -1.0%, latency +28%, mem x3.0. INT8: acc -0.5%, latency +36%, mem x2.6.
- Mistral-7B GPTQ-4: acc -2.4%, latency +12%, mem x3.5. AWQ-4: acc -0.8%, latency +16%, mem x3.1. FP8 (pilot): acc -0.6%, latency +6%, good mem but brittle on >4k contexts.
- Qwen-7B GPTQ-4: acc -0.6%, latency +11%, mem x3.0. Qwen-13B spot-check GPTQ-4: acc -1.2%, saw KV duplication on very long traces.

mike: Mistral GPTQ looks worse. reason?

erin: two main causes found: tokenizer variant mismatch early in the pipeline affected ~6% of examples (patched), and attention accumulator rounding differences on Mistral microkernel amplifying on reasoning tasks. runtime kernel tweak needed.

julia: hallucination / safety notes?

erin: TruthfulQA: GPTQ-4 increased hallucination rate +1.5% avg, AWQ-4 +0.6%. convo-eval surfaced 10 high-confidence regressions, mostly Llama-13B-GPTQ related to prompt truncation and anchor drift.

oz: any blocking runtime issues for Dedicated deployment?

erin: two worth flagging:
- Qwen-13B GPTQ-4: rare KV index corruption after ~9k tokens causing repeated tokens. Mitigation: enable 8-token re-scan fallback; permanent fix in runtime packer.
- Non-deterministic divergence on Mistral GPTQ runs in convo-eval. Recommend canary on AWQ until kernel change lands.

quant-ci-bot: sweep finished (run 1719239000). artifacts at s3://redwood-quant-bake/1719239000/ (metrics.json, logs/, diffs.tar.gz). tokenizer-issues.log present.

mike: reproducibility command for infra?

erin: run used by the harness:

```
docker run --rm -v /tmp/qaart:/artifacts redwood/quant-eval:prod-2024 \
  python run_eval.py --model /artifacts/models/mistral-7b-gptq4 --suites mmlu,piqa,hellaswag,truthfulqa --max_tokens 512 --seed 1234 --out /artifacts/results.json
```

julia: deployment recs:
- Hosted: prefer AWQ-4 for 7B models (best Q/latency). GPTQ-4 usable for 13B after KV patch.
- Dedicated: for strict long-context SLOs, stick to INT8/FP16 on 13B for now. AWQ-4 safe on 7B.
- Private: ship both images; require canaries and convo-eval monitors before customer flip.

oz: cost proxies per 1k tokens (FP16=1.0): Llama-13B GPTQ-4 ~0.30x, Mistral-7B AWQ-4 ~0.27x, Qwen-7B GPTQ-4 ~0.29x.

mike: actions?

erin: listed:
1) ENG-3256: eng-runtime investigate Mistral accumulator divergence (owner: oz)
2) ENG-3257: fix Qwen KV packing + add re-scan fallback (owner: mike)
3) eng-ml: AWQ-4 7B canaries + 48h convo/reg monitor (owner: julia)
4) infra: publish artifact bundle + seed scripts (owner: infra-team)

julia: i'll add canary plan to the RFC and tag rollout channel.

oz: picking up ENG-3256; starting microbench to repro.

infra-team: artifacts uploaded. see s3 path above.

mike: thanks everyone, posting summary to the bakeoff RFC tomorrow.
